gloss: to recall; to imagine; to picture

definitions.gloss: to recall; to remember; to bring to mind
definitions.explanation: To consciously remember or call up a memory, image, or thought from the past.

definitions.gloss: to imagine; to picture; to visualize
definitions.explanation: To form a mental image of something, whether real or imaginary.

examples.japanese: {故郷|こきょう}の{風景|ふうけい}を{思|おも}い{浮|う}かべた。
examples.english: I recalled the scenery of my hometown.

examples.japanese: {完成|かんせい}した{作品|さくひん}を{思|おも}い{浮|う}かべながら{制作|せいさく}した。
examples.english: I created it while imagining the completed work.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{顔|かお}を{思|おも}い{浮|う}かべると、{涙|なみだ}が{出|で}てくる。
examples.english: When I picture his face, tears come to my eyes.

notes:
CONJUGATION:
・{思|おも}い{浮|う}かべる → {思|おも}い{浮|う}かべない (negative)
・{思|おも}い{浮|う}かべる → {思|おも}い{浮|う}かべて (te-form)
・{思|おも}い{浮|う}かべる → {思|おも}い{浮|う}かべた (past)

FORMATION:
Compound verb: {思|おも}う (to think) + {浮|う}かべる (to float, to bring to surface)

The image of "floating" a thought or memory to the surface of consciousness.

COLLOCATIONS:
・{顔|かお}を{思|おも}い{浮|う}かべる - to picture someone's face
・{思|おも}い{出|で}を{思|おも}い{浮|う}かべる - to recall memories
・{場面|ばめん}を{思|おも}い{浮|う}かべる - to picture a scene
・{将来|しょうらい}を{思|おも}い{浮|う}かべる - to envision the future

TRANSITIVITY PAIR:
・{思|おも}い{浮|う}かぶ (intransitive) - to come to mind, to occur to
・{思|おも}い{浮|う}かべる (transitive) - to recall, to imagine (actively)
